title: Audit delivery: SLA-driven PDF/CSV bundles with signed manifests and residency routing
creator: Aisha Tan
description: Problem: Customers require tamper-evident, residency-aware delivery of compliance evidence in both human-readable (PDF) and machine-readable (CSV/NDJSON) formats. Existing scheduled exports are region-agnostic and lack per-tenant residency override controls, signed manifests, incremental delta support, and an operational dashboard for SLA-triggered dispatch.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Admins can create export schedules from the Compliance > Exports console that produce a single signed bundle containing PDFs (human audit briefs) and CSVs (raw event rows) per tenant.

2) Export bundles are routed by tenant residency rules: writes-data-region -> primary export region. For tenants with 'resident-only' flag, bundles never leave the region and are uploaded to a region-restricted bucket.

3) Each bundle includes a signed manifest (SHA-256 per file + manifest signature) and a machine-verifiable delivery receipt; signatures use customer KMS when tenant opts in, otherwise Redwood-managed signing key.

4) SLA-triggered exports: the system detects retention/SLA risk windows (e.g., retention policy nearing deletion or policy mismatch) and can auto-schedule an emergency export; PM/owner is notified and can approve auto-dispatch.
5) Dashboard: display schedule health, last-run status, size, duration, and retention window snapshots; provide manual rerun and partial-replay with delta extraction.

6) Delivery channels supported: presigned S3 with residency-scoped buckets, HTTPS webhook with signed manifest handshake, and on-prem connector (agent pickup); all channels produce an audit log entry per delivery attempt.
7) Performance/scale: job creation <5s, first file archived within 120s for small tenants (<100k events), bundle max size cap and chunking for large tenants (>2GB) with index file for reassembly.
8) End-to-end integration tests and a compliance smoke test checklist exist in CI (PRs must add tests).
out_of_scope: Full document signing verification UI for customers (will be part of a follow-up project to expose public keys and signature verification helpers). Long-term legal-certified notarization is out of scope for this ticket.
implementation_notes: Backend: new export orchestration service (export-sentinel) that subscribes to schedule queue and SLA events. Export pipeline stages: collect -> delta-compact -> format (PDF/CSV) -> bundle -> sign -> route -> deliver -> record-audit. Use streaming generation to avoid materializing full payload in-memory. Use region-aware storage backends and tenant KMS integration. Console: new Exports dashboard view, schedule form, and emergency export modal. API: admin endpoints to create/read/update/delete schedules and trigger runs with idempotency tokens.
metrics: % of successful scheduled exports by tenant (SLA)
number of emergency exports triggered per week
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag behind 'exports.v2' per org. 2) Beta with 5 pilot tenants (legal/finance teams) in US and EU. 3) Collect feedback, monitor metrics for 2 weeks, expand to GA. Emergency export auto-dispatch default off for tenants until opt-in confirmed.
